title: The Mercy of Gods
author: James S. A. Corey
note: conf=0.97; Verified: The Mercy of Gods is the first novel of The Captive's War trilogy by James S. A. Corey (pseudonym of Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck), published by Orbit, August 2024. Amazon lists it as "The Captive's War Book 1"; Goodreads lists it as The Captive's War #1. Filename's "Circle Production" is a scanner/packager artifact, not the publisher; the 9780356517803 ISBN corresponds to the Orbit UK edition while the EPUB metadata ISBN 9780316525558 is the Orbit US edition.
